query: Name a musician that worked with Hiren Roy and Vilayat Khan.

pipeline_result.response: You are correct in identifying Vilayat Khan as one of the most well-known sitar makers in India, along with Nikhil Banerjee, Nikhil Banerjee's younger brother Imrat Khan.
retrieved_context: Hiren Roy: Hiren Roy (1920–1992) was for many years considered to be the best sitar maker in India.  Many great musicians, including Nikhil Banerjee, Vilayat Khan, Annapurna Devi, and Ravi Shankar, have sworn by his creations.

Vilayat Khan: Ustad Vilayat Khan (28 August 1928 – 13 March 2004) was one of India's well known sitar maestros.  Along with Ravi Shankar, Ali Akbar Khan, Nikhil Banerjee and his younger brother Imrat Khan, Vilayat Khan helped introduce Indian Classical Music to the West.
